versions.description: The DNS records operator of Norca (norca-dns of norca-platform) as one release: the norca.io/DNSRecord object kind, the ACL policy bound to its job and the job, which keeps the record sets of the DNSRecord objects (A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT; values given or taken from a LoadBalancer object) in the DNS zones of norca-provider that allow records, under the allow list of each namespace.
